description: The build data of the harnesses: a strip length at each end of every wire, the contact EX-CONTACT-22 with its crimp tool on the device pins in use, sleeving, heat shrink, a label and a backshell on W001, the example pigtail colour code by pin and the Cover of the harness plans. W001 was built and tested: its as-built record says one wire was cut 25 mm too long, out of the tolerance of 10 mm. Look at export --harness-plan, the Cut list and Connectors sheets of the build workbook and asbuilt DIR; the manual pages Enter the build data, Export the harness plans and Record what was built explain it.
name: Build data and as-built (EXAMPLE)
